notes: All 33 planned steps complete and validated on real hardware (pi3b.local), plus a post-deployment latency investigation and fix (recorded at the end of tasks.md): compositeLetterboxed now takes a scaler parameter, NearestNeighbor for the instant-nav thumbnail (~4.1x faster, 466ms->113ms/op per a controlled benchmark) vs CatmullRom for the background-decoded full image. specs/drm-renderer/EvalReport.md then ran a fresh-context Phase 5 eval: verdict FAIL, 5 blocker-class findings + 8 warnings. F11 (stale '~13x' comments) fixed alongside. Two findings are explicitly decisions for the user, not code defects: F1 (RSS ~190-200MB vs the 25-40MB target -- Analyst.md's 'hard gate or a direction?' question is still open, and doesn't yet reflect that the user's actual goal was latency, which was met) and F5 (18.8% coverage vs the generic rubric's 80%, though the design deliberately routes DRM/VT verification to hardware). 8 warnings (F6-F10, F12-F13) are surfaced but not yet acted on, pending user direction.
